title: Warm Smoky Uruguayan Tomato Skewers
description: A smoky and tender Uruguayan dish featuring confit tomatoes and peppercorns, perfect for a light snack or appetizer. This macrobiotic-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, mix together the smoked paprika, garlic powder, and salt.
Thread the cherry tomatoes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each tomato.
Brush the tomatoes with olive oil and sprinkle with the smoked paprika mixture.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the tomatoes are tender and lightly charred.
Meanwhile, grind the black peppercorns in a spice grinder or with a mortar and pestle until coarsely ground.
Sprinkle the ground peppercorns over the grilled tomatoes.
Drizzle the skewers with lemon juice and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the skewers warm, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
